Equipment
 Gravity filter backwash pump
 Manufacture PACO
 Industries "USA"

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 which must be performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title 
 block.

This 
 pump is used to gravity filters backwash.

The first draft initiated by Eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawe, 
 tested at September 2008 revised by MDEP Co. Quality control Eng. Magdy 
 Hegazy, accepted by Eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel 
 Mageed Sowan

This document accepted by Eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
 inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified 
 by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor.

Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator
Vibro meter, straight edge, rags
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump.

Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the 
 setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.
Check the Temperature of bearing .
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal.
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Adjust the mechanical seal leakage.
Adjust piping for leak.
Check the fixation.

sections.text:
Before starting the pump, the 
following steps should be checked

items:
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise.

The check must be carried out be qualified and competent 
 operators , starting the motor for a few second.
Filling the pump casing with the liquid.
Fill suction line with liquid and completely prime pump.
Turn rotation element by hand to make sure it rotates freely.
Tighten plugs in gauge and drain taps.

Check suction and discharge piping for leaks , and make sure 
 for flange bolts are securely tighten need

sections.text:
Attendance and checking during operation of 
the pump, the following should be checked:

items: Check of flow rate and delivery head.
Check the shaft seal for leaks.

Check that the current absorbed by the motor does not exceed 
 the rated value shown on the name plate.
Check the pump pressure.
Install coupling guard on flexible coupled unit.

Fully open gate valve (if any ) in suction line , and close 
 gate valve in discharge line.

Tested
